name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's path to motorsport HR was a bit unconventional. He spent years in general administration for a large agricultural cooperative before a chance encounter with a racing team owner at a local festival sparked his interest. He saw an opportunity to apply his organizational skills and passion for people within a more exciting environment. He completed several online HR courses and leveraged his network to secure an internship, quickly proving his worth.

He believes in fostering a supportive and inclusive team environment, understanding that even the most skilled mechanics or engineers need to feel valued and respected to perform at their best. His approach is hands-on; he's not afraid to get involved in conflict resolution or employee development initiatives. What sets him apart is his ability to connect with people from all backgrounds, creating a cohesive and motivated workforce.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Zoltán is of average height, with a warm smile and a slightly rounded face.

quirks: Always has a thermos of strong black coffee on his desk.
Known to mediate conflicts with folksy Hungarian proverbs.
Keeps a small collection of vintage racing posters in his office.
